note: Hand truth for the hand-written .eml sources under eml/, one entry per source, in the shape of ../generated/truth.json: headers decoded from their encoded words, times in UTC, bodies decoded, line breaks written as \n, and a field the source doesn't have left out. It adds the threading and priority fields as schema "1" writes them: conversation_topic is Thread-Topic, decoded; conversation_index is Thread-Index, base64-decoded, in lowercase hex; importance is Importance, else X-Priority's band (1 to 2 high, 3 normal, 4 to 5 low); and sensitivity is Sensitivity, Company-Confidential written as confidential. The body's lines starting "From " and ">From " are the ones an mbox quotes.

body.text:
